deadline.value: Postgraduate research applications are open all year round; no fixed PhD deadline is given on the programme page.
deadline.quote: Postgraduate Research applications are open all year round on our website.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants may identify a potential supervisor and contact them before applying; the page does not say agreement is required.
supervisor.quote: You may want to identify a potential supervisor and contact them to discuss your research proposal before you apply.

funding.value: Some projects are linked to a highly competitive IAPETUS2 studentship; others are available only to self-funded students.
funding.quote: This project has been advertised as a potential project for an IAPETUS2 studentship (highly competitive). | This project is currently available for self-funded students.

entry_route.value: The usual standard is a 2.1 honours degree; the page states no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: Our regular standard of admission is usually a 2.1 honours degree
